checks.name: Stateless Sanctum Authentication Enforcement
checks.description: All /api/v1/ routes (except /auth/login) must require auth:sanctum middleware.

checks.name: BOLA / IDOR Model Policy Authorization
checks.description: Controller actions with route model binding must call $this->authorize('action', $model).
checks.remediation: Invoke $this->authorize('view', $project) in show, update, destroy actions.

checks.name: Tenant Isolation in Query Lists
checks.description: Index queries must filter by auth()->id() or tenant relationship.

checks.name: Granular Token Ability Scopes
checks.description: Mutating endpoints must enforce token abilities via ability middleware.

checks.name: Token Expiration Configuration
checks.description: Sanctum personal access tokens must have explicit expiration configured.

checks.name: API Rate Limiting Throttle Middleware
checks.description: API endpoints must apply throttle:60,1 to prevent brute force and denial of service.
checks.remediation: Apply throttle:api or throttle:60,1 in routes/api.php.

checks.name: Strict Eloquent API Resource Serialization
checks.description: Controllers must return API Resources rather than raw Eloquent models to prevent password/token leaks.
checks.remediation: Wrap model responses in ProjectResource::make($project) or ProjectResource::collection($projects).

checks.name: Spatie Allowed Filters Whitelist
checks.description: Spatie QueryBuilder must explicitly whitelist allowedFilters and allowedSorts to prevent arbitrary column filtering.

checks.name: Rootless Dockerfile Execution
checks.description: Container process must execute as unprivileged user 10001:10001.

checks.name: No Secret Tokens in Source Code or VCS
checks.description: Source code and git history must not contain unencrypted API keys or token hashes.
checks.remediation: Store all secrets in .env and add .env to .gitignore.

checks.name: Strict CORS Configuration
checks.description: CORS must restrict allowed origins and not use wildcard '*' with credentials.
checks.remediation: Configure config/cors.php with explicit allowed_origins from APP_URL.

checks.name: Form Request Validation with Typed Rules
checks.description: All mutating requests must be validated through custom FormRequest classes.
checks.remediation: Inject StoreProjectRequest and UpdateProjectRequest instead of Request.

checks.name: CSRF Disabled on Stateless API Routes
checks.description: Stateless API routes must not use CSRF cookies; Bearer tokens provide intrinsic CSRF immunity.

checks.name: Database Transaction Wrapping for Compound Writes
checks.description: Operations updating multiple tables must execute inside DB::transaction().
